messages:
Mina: Quick heads-up — ran a perf sweep against dedicated pools this morning. Seeing a 12-18% tail latency bump for /v1/generate around 04:10-04:25 UTC. Looks correlated with a kernel selection change and a KV miss spike. :thinking:
Ajay: Can you share a sample request id + trace?
Mina: Pasting one trace + the token-level timeline we collected. Trace link: https://traces.int/redwood/trace/0x7f9c6b?span=42
Mina: ```
request_id=6f2a3b
route=/v1/generate
kernel_selected=matmul_v2
batch_size=1
kv_hits=0
latency_tokens_ms=[12, 5, 8, 30, 120, 110, 7]
```
Sara: Hmm kv_hits=0 for the warm prefix — that explains the token spike mid-request. Did the runtime switch kernels because of a seq-len heuristic?
Ryan: We shipped a tiny change that prefers matmul_v2 for mixed-precision fallback if shape >= 2048. Could be mis-triggering for short sequences if pad/shape detection is noisy.
Mina: Timeline shows kernel switch at token index 4, which coincides with a KV miss and a batching boundary. Proposal: add a token-level attribute `kernel_reason` and include `kv_status` in the per-token metric so the waterfall links to spans.
PerfBot: profiling-job #1278 finished. Top anomalies: matmul_v2 95p latency +22% vs baseline; KV miss rate +9% on /v1/generate in zone us-west1.
Ajay: Nice. How do we wire that into the console? We need per-route token breakdown + a jump-to-trace link on each token span so SREs can open the full trace and logs. UX: token timeline -> token popover -> "Open trace at span" link.
Zoe: For implementation: runtime should emit `trace_id` and `span_id` annotations on the token-level metrics endpoint, e.g. metric line: `tokens.latency{route=/v1/generate, kernel=matmul_v2, kv=miss, trace_id=0x7f9c6b, span=42}=30`
Zoe: Then dashboards can generate link template `https://traces.int/redwood/trace/${trace_id}?span=${span}`.
Sara: We should also include `batch_origin` (e.g., single, auto-batched, mixed) so we can split tail causes between batching and kernel selection.
Mina: Agreed. I'll open a small RFC/PR: add `kernel_reason`, `kv_status`, `batch_origin`, `trace_id`, `span_id` to the token metrics payload and update the per-request breakdown UI to render clickable token spans.
Mina: Short-term mitigation: add a routing rule to prefer matmul_v1 for routes with observed KV cold starts until we have the instrumentation in place.
Ryan: I'll prep the fallback rule and a canary in us-west1; ETA today EOD.
Ajay: Can we also add an alert that watches for sudden increases in token-level median for the first 10 tokens? That seems to catch cold-KV regressions quickly.
PerfBot: alert created: ALRT-3592 - "route token startup median spike" (threshold: +10% over 1h baseline).
Zoe: I'll pick up the UI piece for the breadcrumb + trace link. Will stub the API contract and post the PR link here.
Mina: Thanks all — plan: PR for metrics + UI stub by tomorrow, fallback rule live in canary today, follow-up perf sweep once instrumentation lands. :thumbsup:
